description: Answers 'can I get tickets for this event?' for one event: refreshed from the live source at call time, returning current availability and starting price. max_price is a hard gate — the event is reported only if its starting price is at or below it (otherwise availability:null with a note); quantity is informational context only, not a reservation. Use get_event when you need the event's full record, get_deals to browse by budget instead. Note: the catalog API does not expose section-level price bands, so only totals and the starting price are returned.

max_price.description: Hard gate in USD: the event is reported only if its starting price is at or below this

quantity.description: Desired ticket quantity (informational context only; does not reserve)

name: get_availability
